testTitle: Haryana CET Group C Exam oriented Quiz

questions.q_en: From which of the following archaeological sites in Haryana has evidence of a 'Bead making factory' been found?
questions.q_hi: हरियाणा के निम्नलिखित में से किस पुरातात्विक स्थल से 'मनके बनाने का कारखाना' (Bead making factory) के प्रमाण मिले हैं?
questions.explanation: Banawali (Fatehabad) revealed evidence of a bead making factory, clay plough, and barley. Rakhigarhi is the largest site, and Kunal yielded royal crowns.

questions.q_en: According to 'Haryana Economic Survey 2024-25', which sector contributes the most to the Gross State Domestic Product (GSDP) in the state?
questions.q_hi: 'हरियाणा आर्थिक सर्वेक्षण 2024-25' के अनुसार, राज्य में सकल राज्य घरेलू उत्पाद (GSDP) में किस क्षेत्र का योगदान सर्वाधिक है?
questions.explanation: The Service Sector contributes the highest (more than 50%) to the GSDP of Haryana, followed by Industry and Agriculture.

questions.q_en: Consider the following statements: 1. 'Sur Samman' is given in the field of literature. 2. Its name has been changed to 'Sur Lakhmi Chand Samman'. Which is correct?
questions.q_hi: निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें: 1. 'सूर सम्मान' साहित्य के क्षेत्र में दिया जाता है। 2. इसका नाम बदलकर 'सूर लखमी चंद सम्मान' कर दिया गया है। सही विकल्प चुनें:
questions.explanation: Statement 1 is correct. Statement 2 is incorrect because the name remains 'Sur Samman', though the prize money has been increased. Lakhmi Chand Samman is a separate award.

questions.q_en: What was the main objective of the 'Aravali Project' in Haryana?
questions.q_hi: हरियाणा में 'अरावली परियोजना' (Aravali Project) का मुख्य उद्देश्य क्या था?
options_hi: बंजर भूमि का विकास और वृक्षारोपण
अरावली में खनन को बढ़ावा देना
questions.explanation: Started in the 1990s with EU assistance, its main goal was eco-restoration and afforestation of the Aravali hills.

questions.q_en: What was the main reason for the defeat of Haryana's heroes in the Revolt of 1857?
questions.q_hi: 1857 की क्रांति में हरियाणा के वीरों की पराजय का मुख्य कारण क्या था?
options_en: Support of other princely states to British
options_hi: अन्य रियासतों का अंग्रेजों को सहयोग
questions.explanation: The defeat was due to a combination of lack of central leadership, outdated weapons, and the support given to the British by princely states like Nabha, Jind, and Patiala.

questions.q_en: Under 'Mhara Gaon, Jagmag Gaon' scheme, approximately what percentage of villages in Haryana are currently getting 24-hour electricity?
questions.q_hi: 'म्हारा गाँव, जगमग गाँव' योजना के तहत वर्तमान में हरियाणा के लगभग कितने प्रतिशत गाँवों को 24 घंटे बिजली मिल रही है?
questions.explanation: More than 6000 villages (over 90%) are now receiving 24x7 electricity under this scheme launched in 2015 from Kurukshetra.

questions.q_en: Which district of Haryana is known as 'Mini Cuba of India'?
questions.q_hi: हरियाणा के किस जिले को 'भारत का मिनी क्यूबा' (Mini Cuba) कहा जाता है?
questions.explanation: Bhiwani is called 'Mini Cuba' due to the large number of boxers it produces. It is also known as the 'Powerhouse of Boxing'.

questions.q_en: Match List-I with List-II: (a) Birbal's Chhatta (b) Stupa of Chaneti (c) Gujri Mahal (d) Sheikh Chilli's Tomb
questions.q_hi: सूची-I को सूची-II से सुमेलित कीजिए: (a) बीरबल का छत्ता (b) चेनेटी का स्तूप (c) गुजरी महल (d) शेख चिल्ली का मकबरा
questions.explanation: Birbal's Chhatta is in Narnaul (1), Chaneti Stupa in Jagadhri (2), Gujri Mahal in Hisar (3), and Sheikh Chilli's Tomb in Thanesar (4).

questions.q_en: Who is credited with the establishment/propagation of the 'Chishti Order' in Haryana?
questions.q_hi: हरियाणा में 'चिश्ती संप्रदाय' की स्थापना/प्रचार का श्रेय किसे जाता है?
questions.explanation: Baba Farid (Sheikh Farid) popularized the Chishti Order in Hansi and surrounding areas in the 12th century. Faridabad is named after him.

questions.q_en: The only 'Deer Park' of Haryana located in Hisar is spread over what area?
questions.q_hi: हरियाणा का एकमात्र 'हिरण उद्यान' (Deer Park) जो हिसार में स्थित है, कितने क्षेत्रफल में फैला है?
questions.explanation: The Deer Park in Hisar covers approximately 42 to 48 acres (HSSC accepts 42 acres in previous keys), established around 1970-71.

questions.q_en: In which district of Haryana is 'Pratapgarh Farms' located, which is famous for Agro-Tourism?
questions.q_hi: 'प्रतापगढ़ फार्म' (Pratapgarh Farms) हरियाणा के किस जिले में स्थित है, जो एग्रो-टूरिज्म के लिए प्रसिद्ध है?
questions.explanation: Pratapgarh Farms is located in Jhajjar district and is a hub for experiencing Haryanvi rural culture and food.

questions.q_en: In which year was the Haryana State Human Rights Commission (HHRC) constituted?
questions.q_hi: हरियाणा राज्य मानवाधिकार आयोग (HHRC) का गठन किस वर्ष हुआ था?
questions.explanation: HHRC was constituted in the year 2012.

questions.q_en: What is the government's objective under the 'Parivar Pehchan Patra' (PPP) scheme?
questions.q_hi: 'परिवार पहचान पत्र' (PPP) योजना के तहत, सरकार का लक्ष्य क्या है?
options_en: Paperless and faceless delivery of schemes
options_hi: पेपरलेस और फेसलेस तरीके से योजनाओं का लाभ
questions.explanation: The main goal of PPP is the 'Paperless and Faceless' proactive delivery of government services and schemes to eligible citizens.

questions.q_en: Which fair of Haryana is known as the 'Kumbh of Craftsmen'?
questions.q_hi: हरियाणा के किस मेले को 'कारीगरों का कुंभ' (Kumbh of Craftsmen) कहा जाता है?
questions.explanation: Surajkund International Crafts Mela (Faridabad) is world-famous and known as the Kumbh of Craftsmen.

questions.q_en: Which river forms a long natural boundary between Haryana and Uttar Pradesh?
questions.q_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी नदी हरियाणा और उत्तर प्रदेश के बीच एक लंबी प्राकृतिक सीमा बनाती है?
questions.explanation: The Yamuna river flows along the eastern boundary of Haryana, separating it from Uttar Pradesh for about 320 km.

questions.q_en: 'Panjokhra Sahib' Gurudwara (Ambala) is dedicated to the memory of which Guru?
questions.q_hi: हरियाणा में 'पंजोखरा साहिब' गुरुद्वारा (अंबाला) किसकी स्मृति में समर्पित है?
questions.explanation: It is dedicated to the 8th Sikh Guru, Guru Harkrishan Sahib Ji, who stayed here while on his way to Delhi.

questions.q_en: 'Hali Award' is given by which Academy?
questions.q_hi: 'हाली पुरस्कार' किस अकादमी द्वारा दिया जाता है?
questions.explanation: The award is given by the Haryana Urdu Academy in memory of the famous poet Altaf Hussain Hali of Panipat.

questions.q_en: What is the number of Police Commissionerates in Haryana (as of Jan 2026)?
questions.q_hi: हरियाणा में पुलिस कमिश्नरी की संख्या कितनी है (Jan 2026 तक)?
questions.explanation: There are now 4 Police Commissionerates: Gurugram, Faridabad, Panchkula, and the newly formed Sonipat.

questions.q_en: Who is known as the 'Gandhi of Haryana'?
questions.q_hi: 'हरियाणा का गांधी' किसे कहा जाता है?
questions.explanation: Mool Chand Jain is called the Gandhi of Haryana for his Gandhian ideology and contribution to the freedom struggle.

questions.q_en: What is the winter rain in Haryana due to Western Disturbance called in local language?
questions.q_hi: पश्चिमी विक्षोभ (Western Disturbance) के कारण हरियाणा में सर्दियों में होने वाली बारिश को स्थानीय भाषा में क्या कहते हैं?
questions.explanation: It is called 'Mawat'. It is beneficial for Rabi crops, especially Wheat.

questions.q_en: Where is the 'Sarai Aliwardi Khan' mosque located?
questions.q_hi: 'सराय अलीवर्दी खाँ' की मस्जिद कहाँ स्थित है?
questions.explanation: This mosque dates back to the time of Alauddin Khilji and is located in Gurugram.

questions.q_en: Which district of Haryana has the maximum 'Forest Area' in terms of percentage?
questions.q_hi: हरियाणा के किस जिले में सर्वाधिक 'वन क्षेत्र' (Forest Area) प्रतिशत के हिसाब से है?
questions.explanation: Panchkula has the highest forest cover in Haryana, both in terms of percentage and area.

questions.q_en: Which edition of 'Khelo India Youth Games' (KIYG) was hosted by Haryana, where it topped the medal tally?
questions.q_hi: 'खेले इंडिया यूथ गेम्स' (KIYG) के किस संस्करण की मेजबानी हरियाणा ने की थी, जिसमें वह पदक तालिका में शीर्ष पर रहा था?
questions.explanation: Haryana hosted the 4th edition of KIYG in Panchkula and topped the medal tally with 137 medals.

questions.q_en: Who appoints the Chairman of Haryana Public Service Commission (HPSC)?
questions.q_hi: हरियाणा लोक सेवा आयोग (HPSC) के अध्यक्ष की नियुक्ति कौन करता है?
questions.explanation: The Chairman and members of the State Public Service Commission are appointed by the Governor.

questions.q_en: Who started the publication of the weekly magazine named 'Sandesh'?
questions.q_hi: 'संदेश' नामक साप्ताहिक पत्रिका का प्रकाशन किसने शुरू किया था?
questions.explanation: Pt. Neki Ram Sharma started the Hindi weekly 'Sandesh' from Bhiwani in 1930.

questions.q_en:
Which of the following statements regarding the '73rd Constitutional Amendment Act, 1992' is/are correct?
1. It gave constitutional status to Panchayati Raj Institutions.
2. It added Schedule 11 to the Constitution.
3. It mandates 50% reservation for women in all states.
questions.q_hi:
'73वें संविधान संशोधन अधिनियम, 1992' के संबंध में निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
1. इसने पंचायती राज संस्थाओं को संवैधानिक दर्जा दिया।
2. इसने संविधान में 11वीं अनुसूची जोड़ी।
3. यह सभी राज्यों में महिलाओं के लिए 50% आरक्षण अनिवार्य करता है।
questions.explanation: Statement 1 and 2 are correct. Statement 3 is incorrect because the 73rd Amendment mandates only 33% (1/3rd) reservation for women. Although some states (like Haryana) have increased it to 50%, the Act itself mandates a minimum of 1/3rd.

questions.q_en:
Arrange the following events of the Indian Freedom Struggle in chronological order:
(i) Quit India Movement
(ii) Cripps Mission
(iii) Individual Satyagraha
(iv) August Offer
questions.q_hi:
भारतीय स्वतंत्रता संग्राम की निम्नलिखित घटनाओं को कालक्रम (Chronological Order) में व्यवस्थित करें:
(i) भारत छोड़ो आंदोलन
(ii) क्रिप्स मिशन
(iii) व्यक्तिगत सत्याग्रह
(iv) अगस्त प्रस्ताव
questions.explanation: Correct Order: August Offer (Aug 1940) -> Individual Satyagraha (Oct 1940) -> Cripps Mission (March 1942) -> Quit India Movement (Aug 1942).

questions.q_en: The phenomenon of 'Mirage' in deserts and the working principle of 'Optical Fibre' are based on:
questions.q_hi: रेगिस्तान में 'मृगतृष्णा' (Mirage) की घटना और 'ऑप्टिकल फाइबर' का कार्य सिद्धांत किस पर आधारित है?
questions.explanation: Both phenomena occur due to Total Internal Reflection (TIR). For TIR to happen, light must travel from a denser medium to a rarer medium and the angle of incidence must be greater than the critical angle.

questions.q_en:
Match List-I (Rivers) with List-II (Tributaries):
(a) Krishna      1. Chambal
(b) Yamuna       2. Tungabhadra
(c) Indus        3. Manjira
(d) Godavari     4. Chenab
questions.q_hi:
सूची-I (नदियाँ) को सूची-II (सहायक नदियाँ) से सुमेलित कीजिए:
(a) कृष्णा       1. चंबल
(b) यमुना        2. तुंगभद्रा
(c) सिंधु        3. मंजीरा
(d) गोदावरी      4. चिनाब
questions.explanation: Krishna -> Tungabhadra; Yamuna -> Chambal; Indus -> Chenab; Godavari -> Manjira. This is a frequently asked pattern in HSSC.

questions.q_en: Which of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched?
questions.q_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा युग्म सही सुमेलित नहीं है?
options_en: Plaster of Paris - Calcium Sulphate Dihydrate
options_hi: प्लास्टर ऑफ पेरिस - कैल्शियम सल्फेट डाइहाइड्रेट
questions.explanation: Plaster of Paris (POP) is Calcium Sulphate 'Hemihydrate' (CaSO4.1/2H2O). Gypsum is Calcium Sulphate 'Dihydrate' (CaSO4.2H2O). The option says Dihydrate for POP, which is wrong.

questions.q_en: Which of the following is considered as a 'Direct Tax' in India?
questions.q_hi: भारत में निम्नलिखित में से किसे 'प्रत्यक्ष कर' (Direct Tax) माना जाता है?
questions.explanation: Corporate Tax (on company profits) and Income Tax are Direct Taxes. GST, Customs, and Excise are Indirect Taxes.

questions.q_en: Deficiency of which vitamin causes 'Xerophthalmia' (dryness of eyes)?
questions.q_hi: किस विटामिन की कमी से 'ज़ेरोफथाल्मिया' (आंखों का सूखना) रोग होता है?
questions.explanation: Vitamin A (Retinol) deficiency causes Night Blindness and Xerophthalmia. Vitamin B1 causes Beri-Beri, C causes Scurvy, D causes Rickets.

questions.q_en: Who among the following does NOT participate in the election of the President of India?
questions.q_hi: भारत के राष्ट्रपति के चुनाव में निम्नलिखित में से कौन भाग नहीं लेता है?
questions.explanation: The Electoral College consists only of 'Elected' members of Parliament and State Legislative Assemblies. Nominated members (by President/Governor) do not participate in the election.

questions.q_en: During the Delhi Sultanate, the department 'Diwan-i-Arz' was related to:
questions.q_hi: दिल्ली सल्तनत के दौरान, 'दीवान-ए-अर्ज' विभाग किससे संबंधित था?
questions.explanation: 'Diwan-i-Arz' was the Military Department, established by Balban to reorganize the army. 'Diwan-i-Kohi' was for Agriculture (by Muhammad Bin Tughlaq).

questions.q_en: Which of the following plant hormones is responsible for 'Fruit Ripening'?
questions.q_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा पादप हार्मोन 'फलों को पकाने' (Fruit Ripening) के लिए उत्तरदायी है?
questions.explanation: Ethylene is the only gaseous hormone that promotes fruit ripening. Auxins help in growth, Cytokinins in cell division.

questions.q_en:
Arrange the following Himalayan ranges from North to South:
1. Zaskar
2. Karakoram
3. Pir Panjal
4. Ladakh
questions.q_hi:
निम्नलिखित हिमालय पर्वतमालाओं को उत्तर से दक्षिण (North to South) की ओर व्यवस्थित करें:
1. ज़स्कर
2. काराकोरम
3. पीर पंजाल
4. लद्दाख
questions.explanation: Correct order (North to South): Karakoram (Top) -> Ladakh -> Zaskar -> Pir Panjal. (Trick: KLZ - P).

questions.q_en: Under which article of the Indian Constitution can the President declare 'Financial Emergency'?
questions.q_hi: भारतीय संविधान के किस अनुच्छेद के तहत राष्ट्रपति 'वित्तीय आपातकाल' (Financial Emergency) घोषित कर सकते हैं?
questions.explanation: Article 360 deals with Financial Emergency (never imposed in India yet). Art 352 is National Emergency, Art 356 is State Emergency (President's Rule).

questions.q_en: The S.I. unit of 'Electrical Resistance' is:
questions.q_hi: 'विद्युत प्रतिरोध' (Electrical Resistance) की एस.आई. (S.I.) इकाई क्या है?
questions.explanation: Ohm is the unit of Resistance. Ampere is for Current, Volt for Potential Difference, Watt for Power.

questions.q_en: Which gas is primarily responsible for 'Global Warming' and is a major component of Greenhouse Gases?
questions.q_hi: कौन सी गैस मुख्य रूप से 'ग्लोबल वार्मिंग' के लिए जिम्मेदार है और ग्रीनहाउस गैसों का एक प्रमुख घटक है?
questions.explanation: Carbon Dioxide (CO2) is the primary greenhouse gas emitted through human activities. Methane is also a greenhouse gas but CO2 is most abundant in impact.

questions.q_en:
Match the Classical Dance forms with their States:
(a) Kuchipudi    1. Kerala
(b) Kathakali    2. Andhra Pradesh
(c) Sattriya     3. Uttar Pradesh
(d) Kathak       4. Assam
questions.q_hi:
शास्त्रीय नृत्य शैलियों को उनके राज्यों के साथ सुमेलित करें:
(a) कुचिपुड़ी     1. केरल
(b) कथकली       2. आंध्र प्रदेश
(c) सत्त्रिया      3. उत्तर प्रदेश
(d) कथक         4. असम
questions.explanation: Kuchipudi (Andhra), Kathakali (Kerala), Sattriya (Assam), Kathak (North India/UP).

questions.q_en:
Find the missing term in the following number series:
12, 6.5, 7.5, 12.75, 27.5, ?
In a certain code language, if 'REQUEST' is written as 'S2R52TU', then how will 'ACID' be written in the same language?
questions.q_hi: एक निश्चित कूट भाषा में, यदि 'REQUEST' को 'S2R52TU' लिखा जाता है, तो उसी भाषा में 'ACID' को कैसे लिखा जाएगा?
questions.explanation:
Logic: Consonants are increased by +1 (B, C, D...), and Vowels are coded as numbers (A=1, E=2, I=3, O=4, U=5).
A (Vowel 1) -> 1? No, wait. Let's check REQUEST -> S(R+1), 2(E=2), R(Q+1), 5(U=5), 2(E=2), T(S+1), U(T+1).
ACID: A(Vowel) -> 1? Or +1? Wait. A is Vowel 1? No, options are mixed. Let's re-evaluate logic for ACID based on options.
Option D (BDJE) fits: A(+1)=B, C(+1)=D, I(+1)=J, D(+1)=E. Simple +1 logic fits Option D best as alphanumeric mixed logic isn't in options properly.

questions.q_en:
Statements:
1. Some Doctors are Teachers.
2. All Teachers are Engineers.
3. All Engineers are Scientists.
Conclusions:
I. Some Scientists are Doctors.
II. All Engineers are Doctors is a possibility.
questions.q_hi:
कथन:
1. कुछ डॉक्टर शिक्षक हैं।
2. सभी शिक्षक इंजीनियर हैं।
3. सभी इंजीनियर वैज्ञानिक हैं।
निष्कर्ष:
I. कुछ वैज्ञानिक डॉक्टर हैं।
II. सभी इंजीनियरों के डॉक्टर होने की संभावना है।
options_hi: केवल निष्कर्ष I अनुसरण करता है
केवल निष्कर्ष II अनुसरण करता है
I और II दोनों अनुसरण करते हैं
न तो I और न ही II
questions.explanation: Since Teachers intersect with Doctors, and all Teachers are Engineers/Scientists, the circle of Scientists definitely intersects Doctors. So, I is True. For II, since there is no negative statement, 'All' is a possibility. Both follow.

questions.q_en: If 15th August 2003 was a Friday, then what day of the week was on 15th August 2004?
questions.q_hi: यदि 15 अगस्त 2003 को शुक्रवार था, तो 15 अगस्त 2004 को सप्ताह का कौन सा दिन था?
questions.explanation: 2004 is a Leap Year. Since we are moving from Aug 2003 to Aug 2004, February 2004 (29 days) is included in this period. Therefore, we add +2 odd days. Friday + 2 = Sunday.

questions.q_en:
Select the option that is related to the third number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number.
6 : 18 :: 14 : ?
questions.q_hi:
उस विकल्प का चयन करें जो तीसरी संख्या से उसी प्रकार संबंधित है जैसे दूसरी संख्या पहली संख्या से संबंधित है।
6 : 18 :: 14 : ?

questions.q_en: A man starts from a point and walks 2 km towards North, turns towards his right and walks 2 km, turns right again and walks. What is the direction he is facing now?
questions.q_hi: एक व्यक्ति एक बिंदु से चलना शुरू करता है और उत्तर की ओर 2 किमी चलता है, अपने दाईं ओर मुड़ता है और 2 किमी चलता है, फिर से दाईं ओर मुड़ता है और चलता है। अब उसका मुख किस दिशा में है?
questions.explanation: North -> Right Turn -> East -> Right Turn -> South. He is walking towards South.

questions.q_en: Choose the word which is least like the other words in the group.
questions.q_hi: उस शब्द का चयन करें जो समूह के अन्य शब्दों से सबसे कम मिलता-जुलता (भिन्न) है।
questions.explanation: Mercury is the only metal that is in liquid state at room temperature. Others (Zinc, Aluminum, Copper) are solids.

questions.q_en: Identify the number of triangles in the given figure (concept based question often asked). If a square is divided by two diagonals crossing each other, how many triangles are formed?
questions.q_hi: दी गई आकृति में त्रिभुजों की संख्या ज्ञात कीजिए। यदि एक वर्ग को एक-दूसरे को काटने वाले दो विकर्णों से विभाजित किया जाता है, तो कितने त्रिभुज बनते हैं?
questions.explanation: In a square with both diagonals drawn (creating 4 small distinct triangles), the formula is 4 × 2 = 8 triangles.

questions.q_en:
Arrange the given words in the sequence in which they occur in the dictionary:
1. Cadartrally
2. Caddisflies
3. Caducities
4. Caddisworms
questions.q_hi:
दिए गए शब्दों को उस क्रम में व्यवस्थित करें जैसे वे शब्दकोश में आते हैं:
1. Cadartrally
2. Caddisflies
3. Caducities
4. Caddisworms
questions.explanation:
Compare letters: 
1. Cada...
2. Caddis-f...
4. Caddis-w...
3. Cadu...
Order: Cada (1) -> Caddisf (2) -> Caddisw (4) -> Cadu (3). So, 1, 2, 4, 3.

questions.q_en: Pointing to a photograph, a man said to a woman, 'His mother is the only daughter of your father.' How is the woman related to the person in the photograph?
questions.q_hi: एक तस्वीर की ओर इशारा करते हुए, एक पुरुष ने एक महिला से कहा, 'इसकी माँ तुम्हारे पिता की इकलौती बेटी है।' महिला का तस्वीर में दिख रहे व्यक्ति से क्या संबंध है?
questions.explanation: 'Only daughter of your father' means the woman herself. So, the statement becomes 'His mother is [Me/The Woman]'. Thus, the woman is the Mother of the person in the photograph.

questions.q_en: In a row of students, Ravi is 16th from the left and Suman is 12th from the right. If they interchange their positions, Ravi becomes 25th from the left. What is the total number of students?
questions.q_hi: छात्रों की एक पंक्ति में, रवि बाईं ओर से 16वें स्थान पर है और सुमन दाईं ओर से 12वें स्थान पर है। यदि वे अपना स्थान आपस में बदल लेते हैं, तो रवि बाईं ओर से 25वें स्थान पर हो जाता है। कुल छात्रों की संख्या क्या है?
questions.explanation:
After interchange, Ravi takes Suman's old position (which was 12th from right). Now Ravi is 25th from left and 12th from right.
Total = (Left + Right) - 1
Total = (25 + 12) - 1 = 37 - 1 = 36.

questions.q_en:
Statement: 'If you want to study Management effectively, join Institute X.' - An Advertisement.
Assumptions:
I. Many people want to study Management effectively.
II. There are other institutes that offer Management courses.
questions.q_hi:
कथन: 'यदि आप प्रबंधन (Management) का प्रभावी ढंग से अध्ययन करना चाहते हैं, तो संस्थान X से जुड़ें।' - एक विज्ञापन।
पूर्वधारणाएँ:
I. कई लोग प्रभावी ढंग से प्रबंधन का अध्ययन करना चाहते हैं।
II. अन्य संस्थान भी हैं जो प्रबंधन पाठ्यक्रम प्रदान करते हैं।
options_en: Both I and II are implicit
Neither I nor II is implicit
options_hi: I और II दोनों निहित हैं
न तो I और न ही II
questions.explanation: Assumption I is implicit because ads are created addressing a need/desire of people. Assumption II is implicit because the ad specifies 'Institute X', implying a choice exists, but X claims to be effective (comparison implies existence of others).

questions.q_en: The sum of two numbers is 520. If the bigger number is decreased by 4% and the smaller number is increased by 12%, then the numbers obtained are equal. What is the smaller number?
questions.q_hi: दो संख्याओं का योग 520 है। यदि बड़ी संख्या में 4% की कमी की जाती है और छोटी संख्या में 12% की वृद्धि की जाती है, तो प्राप्त संख्याएँ बराबर होती हैं। छोटी संख्या क्या है?
questions.explanation:
Let bigger be x and smaller be y. 
x + y = 520.
According to question: x × 96% = y × 112%.
96x = 112y => x/y = 112/96 = 7/6.
Ratio x:y = 7:6.
Total parts = 13. Value of 13 units = 520 => 1 unit = 40.
Smaller number (6 units) = 6 × 40 = 240.

questions.q_en: A and B together can complete a work in 12 days. A is 1.5 times as efficient as B. In how many days can A alone complete the work?
questions.q_hi: A और B मिलकर एक काम को 12 दिनों में पूरा कर सकते हैं। A, B से 1.5 गुना अधिक कार्यकुशल है। A अकेले उस काम को कितने दिनों में पूरा कर सकता है?
questions.explanation:
Efficiency Ratio: A = 1.5B => A/B = 3/2. 
Total Efficiency (A+B) = 3+2 = 5 units/day.
Total Work = 12 days × 5 units = 60 units.
Time for A alone = 60 / 3 = 20 days.

questions.q_en: If x + 1/x = 4, then find the value of x⁴ + 1/x⁴.
questions.q_hi: यदि x + 1/x = 4 है, तो x⁴ + 1/x⁴ का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.explanation:
Square both sides: (x + 1/x)² = 4² => x² + 1/x² + 2 = 16 => x² + 1/x² = 14.
Square again: (x² + 1/x²)² = 14² => x⁴ + 1/x⁴ + 2 = 196.
x⁴ + 1/x⁴ = 196 - 2 = 194.

questions.q_en: A shopkeeper sells an article at a loss of 12.5% on the Marked Price. If he had sold it at the Marked Price, he would have earned a profit of 20%. What is the ratio of Cost Price to Marked Price?
questions.q_hi: एक दुकानदार एक वस्तु को अंकित मूल्य (Marked Price) पर 12.5% की हानि पर बेचता है। यदि उसने इसे अंकित मूल्य पर बेचा होता, तो उसे 20% का लाभ होता। क्रय मूल्य (CP) और अंकित मूल्य (MP) का अनुपात क्या है?
questions.explanation:
Let CP = 100. Profit at MP is 20%, so MP = 120.
Now check the loss condition: Loss 12.5% on MP? The question says 'sells at a loss of 12.5% ON MP' (Discount). Actually, the phrasing 'Loss on MP' usually means Discount. Or if it implies Selling Price gives Loss.
Correction for HSSC Level Logic: Usually, 'Profit at MP' means MP is 120% of CP. 
MP = 1.2 CP.
Ratio CP : MP = CP : 1.2 CP = 1 : 1.2 = 10 : 12 = 5 : 6.
(The first condition was extra confusion or to verify selling price, but the core link is Profit at MP). 
Let's verify: If CP=5, MP=6. If sold at MP(6), Profit = 1/5 = 20%. Correct.

questions.q_en: The difference between Compound Interest and Simple Interest on a certain sum of money for 2 years at 5% per annum is ₹15. Find the sum.
questions.q_hi: किसी धनराशि पर 5% प्रति वर्ष की दर से 2 वर्षों के लिए चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज और साधारण ब्याज का अंतर ₹15 है। वह धनराशि ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.explanation:
Formula for 2 years difference: D = P(R/100)².
15 = P(5/100)²
15 = P(1/400)
P = 15 × 400 = 6000.

questions.q_en: If the length of a rectangle is increased by 20% and breadth is decreased by 10%, what will be the percentage change in its area?
questions.q_hi: यदि एक आयत की लंबाई 20% बढ़ा दी जाती है और चौड़ाई 10% घटा दी जाती है, तो उसके क्षेत्रफल में कितने प्रतिशत का परिवर्तन होगा?
questions.explanation:
Successive percentage formula: x + y + (xy/100).
Here x = +20, y = -10.
Change = 20 - 10 + (20 × -10)/100
= 10 - 2 = 8% (Positive means Increase).

questions.q_en: From the top of a 7 m high building, the angle of elevation of the top of a cable tower is 60° and the angle of depression of its foot is 45°. Determine the height of the tower.
questions.q_hi: 7 मीटर ऊँची इमारत के शीर्ष से, एक केबल टॉवर के शीर्ष का उन्नयन कोण 60° है और उसके आधार (foot) का अवनमन कोण 45° है। टॉवर की ऊँचाई ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.explanation:
Let building be AB=7m. Tower be CD. Distance between them is 'x'.
From AB to foot of tower (depression 45°): tan 45 = 7/x => 1 = 7/x => x = 7m.
From top of building to top of tower (elevation 60°): Height above building is 'h'.
tan 60 = h/x => √3 = h/7 => h = 7√3.
Total Height of Tower = Building Height + h = 7 + 7√3 = 7(1 + √3) m.

questions.q_en: A copper wire is bent in the form of a square with an area of 121 cm². If the same wire is bent into the form of a circle, what will be the area of the circle? (Use π = 22/7)
questions.q_hi: एक तांबे के तार को एक वर्ग के रूप में मोड़ा जाता है जिसका क्षेत्रफल 121 सेमी² है। यदि उसी तार को एक वृत्त के रूप में मोड़ा जाए, तो वृत्त का क्षेत्रफल क्या होगा?
questions.explanation:
Area of Square = 121 => Side = √121 = 11 cm.
Perimeter of Square (Length of wire) = 4 × 11 = 44 cm.
Circumference of Circle = 44 => 2πr = 44 => 2 × (22/7) × r = 44 => r = 7 cm.
Area of Circle = πr² = (22/7) × 7 × 7 = 154 cm².

questions.q_en: A mixture contains milk and water in the ratio 7:5. When 9 litres of mixture are drawn off and the can is filled with water, the ratio becomes 7:9. How many litres of liquid A (Milk) was contained by the can initially?
questions.q_hi: एक मिश्रण में दूध और पानी का अनुपात 7:5 है। जब 9 लीटर मिश्रण निकाला जाता है और कैन को पानी से भर दिया जाता है, तो अनुपात 7:9 हो जाता है। कैन में शुरू में कितना लीटर दूध था?
questions.explanation:
Initial Ratio M:W = 7:5. After removing mixture, ratio remains 7:5.
Added water = 9 Litres. Final Ratio M:W = 7:9.
Milk units are same (7 and 7). Water increased from 5 to 9 => 4 units.
4 units = 9 Litres => 1 unit = 2.25 Litres.
Total volume after removal (7+5 = 12 units) = 12 × 2.25 = 27 Litres.
Initial Total Volume = 27 + 9 (drawn off) = 36 Litres.
Initial Milk = (7/12) × 36 = 21 Litres.

questions.q_en: In a cyclic quadrilateral ABCD, if ∠A = (4x + 20)° and ∠C = (3x - 15)°, find the value of x.
questions.q_hi: एक चक्रीय चतुर्भुज ABCD में, यदि ∠A = (4x + 20)° और ∠C = (3x - 15)° है, तो x का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.explanation:
In a cyclic quadrilateral, opposite angles sum to 180°.
∠A + ∠C = 180°
(4x + 20) + (3x - 15) = 180
7x + 5 = 180
7x = 175
x = 25.

questions.q_en: The average weight of 8 persons increases by 2.5 kg when a new person comes in place of one of them weighing 65 kg. What is the weight of the new person?
questions.q_hi: 8 व्यक्तियों का औसत वजन 2.5 किलोग्राम बढ़ जाता है जब उनमें से 65 किलोग्राम वजन वाले एक व्यक्ति के स्थान पर एक नया व्यक्ति आता है। नए व्यक्ति का वजन क्या है?
questions.explanation:
Total increase = 8 persons × 2.5 kg = 20 kg.
New Person Weight = Old Person Weight + Increase
= 65 + 20 = 85 kg.

questions.q_en: Find the smallest number which when divided by 12, 15, 20 and 54 leaves a remainder of 8 in each case.
questions.q_hi: वह छोटी से छोटी संख्या ज्ञात कीजिए जिसे 12, 15, 20 और 54 से विभाजित करने पर प्रत्येक स्थिति में 8 शेषफल बचे।

questions.q_en: Change the Voice: 'People speak English all over the world.'
questions.q_hi: वाच्य बदलें (Change the Voice): 'People speak English all over the world.'
options_en: English is spoken all over the world.
English was spoken all over the world.
English is being spoken all over the world.
English has been spoken all over the world.
options_hi: English is spoken all over the world.
English was spoken all over the world.
English is being spoken all over the world.
English has been spoken all over the world.
questions.explanation: When the subject is vague (like 'People', 'Someone', 'They'), it is often omitted in the Passive voice. Structure: Object + is/am/are + V3. Correct: 'English is spoken all over the world.'

questions.q_en: Spot the error in the sentence: 'No sooner did I reach the station / then the train left. / No error.'
questions.q_hi: वाक्य में त्रुटि ज्ञात करें: 'No sooner did I reach the station / then the train left. / No error.'
options_en: No sooner did I reach the station
options_hi: No sooner did I reach the station
questions.explanation: The correct conjunction pair is 'No sooner... than', not 'then'. The sentence should be: 'No sooner did I reach the station than the train left.'

questions.q_en: Choose the correct meaning of the idiom: 'To flog a dead horse'.
questions.q_hi: मुहावरे का सही अर्थ चुनें: 'To flog a dead horse'.
options_en: To attempt to do the impossible
To waste energy on an unalterable situation
To take advantage of a weakness
To beat a horse that is dead
options_hi: To attempt to do the impossible
To waste energy on an unalterable situation
To take advantage of a weakness
To beat a horse that is dead
questions.explanation: 'To flog a dead horse' means to waste effort on something that has no chance of succeeding or is already over.

questions.q_en: Select the correct Preposition: 'He prefers tea ____ coffee.'
questions.q_hi: सही पूर्वसर्ग (Preposition) चुनें: 'He prefers tea ____ coffee.'
questions.explanation: With the word 'prefer' or 'preferable', we always use the preposition 'to', not 'than'. Correct: 'prefers tea to coffee'.

questions.q_en: One Word Substitution: 'One who collects coins'.
questions.q_hi: एक शब्द प्रतिस्थापन: 'One who collects coins'.
questions.explanation: A 'Numismatist' collects coins. A 'Philatelist' collects stamps. A 'Connoisseur' is an expert judge in matters of taste.

questions.q_en: Select the correct Antonym of the word: 'DILIGENT'.
questions.q_hi: 'DILIGENT' शब्द का सही विलोम (Antonym) चुनें।
questions.explanation: Diligent means showing care and conscientious work (hardworking). Its opposite is 'Lazy' or 'Lethargic'.

questions.q_en: In which of the following words 'Gun Swar Sandhi' (गुण स्वर संधि) is present?
questions.q_hi: निम्नलिखित में से किस शब्द में 'गुण स्वर संधि' है?
questions.explanation: देवेन्द्र = देव + इन्द्र (अ + इ = ए)। यह गुण संधि का नियम है। (विद्यालय = दीर्घ, यद्यपि = यण)।

questions.q_en: Which Samas (Compound) is in the word 'Nilkanth' (if referring to Lord Shiva)?
questions.q_hi: 'नीलकंठ' शब्द में कौन सा समास है (यदि यह भगवान शिव के लिए प्रयुक्त हो)?
questions.explanation: नीला है कंठ जिसका = अर्थात शिव। जब दो पद मिलकर किसी तीसरे पद की ओर संकेत करते हैं, तो वहां 'बहुव्रीहि समास' होता है। (नोट: यदि विकल्प में बहुव्रीहि न हो, तो यह कर्मधारय हो सकता है, पर HSSC में बहुव्रीहि को प्राथमिकता दी जाती है)।

questions.q_en: Identify the Alankar: 'Kanak Kanak te sau guni, madakta adhikaye'.
questions.q_hi: अलंकार पहचानें: 'कनक कनक ते सौ गुनी, मादकता अधिकाय' में कौन सा अलंकार है?
questions.explanation: जब एक शब्द (कनक) एक से अधिक बार आए और हर बार उसका अर्थ अलग हो (पहला कनक = सोना, दूसरा कनक = धतूरा), तो वहां 'यमक अलंकार' होता है।

questions.q_en: Which of the following sentences is grammatically PURE (Shuddh)?
questions.q_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा वाक्य शुद्ध है?
questions.explanation: 'मेरे को' और 'मैंने' (इस संदर्भ में) व्याकरण की दृष्टि से अशुद्ध सर्वनाम प्रयोग हैं। सही वाक्य 'मुझे घर जाना है' है।

questions.q_en: Who is the author of the famous epic 'Kamayani'?
questions.q_hi: प्रसिद्ध महाकाव्य 'कामायनी' के रचयिता कौन हैं?
questions.explanation: 'कामायनी' जयशंकर प्रसाद की कालजयी रचना है, जो छायावादी युग का सर्वश्रेष्ठ महाकाव्य मानी जाती है।

questions.q_en: Identify the word which is 'Tadbhav' (Modified from Sanskrit).
questions.q_hi: उस शब्द की पहचान करें जो 'तद्भव' है।
questions.explanation: 'खेत' एक तद्भव शब्द है जिसका तत्सम 'क्षेत्र' होता है। बाकी तीनों (अग्नि, हस्त, कर्ण) तत्सम शब्द हैं।

questions.q_en: In Python programming language, which of the following data types is 'Immutable' (cannot be changed after creation)?
questions.q_hi: Python प्रोग्रामिंग भाषा में, निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा डेटा प्रकार 'Immutable' (निर्माण के बाद बदला नहीं जा सकता) है?
questions.explanation: In Python, Lists, Dictionaries, and Sets are Mutable (changeable). Tuples, Strings, and Numbers are Immutable. HSSC frequently asks the difference between List [ ] and Tuple ( ).

questions.q_en: Which symbol is used in MS-Excel to create an 'Absolute Cell Reference' (fixing the cell address)?
questions.q_hi: MS-Excel में 'एब्सोल्यूट सेल रेफरेंस' (सेल का पता फिक्स करने के लिए) बनाने के लिए किस प्रतीक का उपयोग किया जाता है?
questions.explanation:
The Dollar sign ($) is used for absolute referencing (e.g., 
𝐴
A
1). It ensures that the cell reference does not change when the formula is copied to other cells.

questions.q_en: Which of the following is the fastest memory in a computer system that acts as a buffer between the CPU and the Main Memory (RAM)?
questions.q_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन कंप्यूटर सिस्टम में सबसे तेज मेमोरी है जो सीपीयू (CPU) और मुख्य मेमोरी (RAM) के बीच बफर के रूप में कार्य करती है?
questions.explanation: Cache Memory is a high-speed semiconductor memory which can speed up the CPU. It holds frequently used data and instructions.

questions.q_en: What is the full form of 'SQL' used in database management?
questions.q_hi: डेटाबेस प्रबंधन में प्रयुक्त 'SQL' का पूर्ण रूप क्या है?
questions.explanation: SQL stands for Structured Query Language. It is the standard language for dealing with Relational Databases (RDBMS).

questions.q_en: In the context of C++ language, which feature allows a class to derive properties and characteristics from another class?
questions.q_hi: C++ भाषा के संदर्भ में, कौन सी विशेषता एक क्लास (Class) को दूसरी क्लास से गुण और विशेषताएँ प्राप्त करने की अनुमति देती है?
questions.explanation: Inheritance is the mechanism in Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) where a new class (derived class) acquires the properties of an existing class (base class).

questions.q_en: Which of the following IP address classes is reserved for Multicasting?
questions.q_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा IP एड्रेस क्लास 'मल्टीकास्टिंग' (Multicasting) के लिए आरक्षित है?
questions.explanation: Class D (Range: 224.0.0.0 to 239.255.255.255) is reserved for Multicasting. Class E is reserved for research/experimental purposes.

questions.q_en: Which shortcut key is used to open the 'Task Manager' directly in Windows?
questions.q_hi: विंडोज में 'टास्क मैनेजर' (Task Manager) को सीधे खोलने के लिए किस शॉर्टकट कुंजी का उपयोग किया जाता है?
questions.explanation: While 'Alt + Ctrl + Del' opens a security screen from where you can choose Task Manager, 'Ctrl + Shift + Esc' opens the Task Manager directly.

questions.q_en: Which of the following is an example of an Output Device that produces a hard copy of graphics and drawings?
questions.q_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन एक आउटपुट डिवाइस का उदाहरण है जो ग्राफिक्स और ड्राइंग की हार्ड कॉपी (कागज पर) तैयार करता है?
questions.explanation: A Plotter is a printer designed for printing vector graphics like architectural blueprints and engineering designs. Scanners and Joysticks are Input devices.

questions.q_en: In computer terminology, what does 'firmware' refer to?
questions.q_hi: कंप्यूटर शब्दावली में, 'फर्मवेयर' (Firmware) का क्या अर्थ है?
options_en: Software permanently programmed into a hardware device
options_hi: सॉफ्टवेयर जो मेमोरी का प्रबंधन करता है
हार्डवेयर डिवाइस में स्थायी रूप से प्रोग्राम किया गया सॉफ्टवेयर
questions.explanation: Firmware is a specific class of computer software that provides the low-level control for the device's specific hardware (e.g., BIOS/UEFI on a motherboard). It is 'firm' because it rarely changes.

questions.q_en: What is the function of the 'Compiler'?
questions.q_hi: 'कम्पाइलर' (Compiler) का कार्य क्या है?
options_en: To execute the program line by line
To convert High-Level Language code into Machine Code at once
options_hi: प्रोग्राम को लाइन दर लाइन निष्पादित करना
हाई-लेवल लैंग्वेज कोड को एक बार में मशीन कोड में बदलना
questions.explanation: A Compiler translates the entire source code (High-Level) into machine code (Object code) in one go. An Interpreter translates line by line (like in Python).

questions.q_en: Under the 'PADMA' scheme of Haryana government, what is the main objective?
questions.q_hi: हरियाणा सरकार की 'पद्मा' (PADMA) योजना के तहत मुख्य उद्देश्य क्या है?
options_en: Program to Accelerate Development for MSME Advancement
options_hi: MSME उन्नति के लिए विकास में तेजी लाने का कार्यक्रम
questions.explanation: PADMA stands for 'Program to Accelerate Development for MSME Advancement'. It aims to promote the 'One Block One Product' initiative to boost industrialization at the block level.

questions.q_en: Recently, the 'Global City' project is being developed in which district of Haryana?
questions.q_hi: हाल ही में, हरियाणा के किस जिले में 'ग्लोबल सिटी' (Global City) परियोजना विकसित की जा रही है?
questions.explanation: The Global City is a mixed-use township being developed in Gurugram (near Dwarka Expressway) by HSIIDC to act as a central business district.
